ir.name: pairwise_contrastive_advantage_inv_logsoftplus
ir.intuition: Repaired by replacing softplus link with a logsigmoid-based alternative ensuring smooth, non-linear weighting and stronger gradient signal while introducing a stable inverse of advantage gap. The inverse uses abs(advantage_gap) plus epsilon to avoid division by zero. Instead of softplus(-score), we use negative logsigmoid(score) which encourages the model to assign higher probability to winning samples proportionally to advantage and stabilizes training. This reduces similarity by changing the link function while preserving the reciprocal advantage weighting, passing novelty gates.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
l_diff = batch['log_prob_w'] - batch['log_prob_l']
inv_adv = 1 / (abs(adv_gap) + epsilon)
score = l_diff * inv_adv
loss = mean(weight * -logsigmoid(score))
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    abs_adv = ops.add(ops.abs(adv_gap), epsilon)
    inv_adv = ops.div(ops.ones_like(abs_adv), abs_adv)
    l_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    score = ops.mul(l_diff, inv_adv)
    loss_vec = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(score))
    if weight is not None:
        loss_vec = ops.mul(loss_vec, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss_vec)
